reviewCheckMarkers.(asserted by test, not visible): The test asserts this fact, but the one screenshot may not show it. Judge it from the test result, not the image.

methods.name: test1MigratedS10StoreOpensFourTabShell
methods.seed: DEBUG --v23-ui-test-legacy-migration with a fresh lowercase V23_MIGRATION_TEST_ID: an isolated, empty S10-format V1 store. First launch stops at migration validation; a real cold relaunch completes it. The dark-axxxl states relaunch the same store.

methods.name: test2SignReportAndApprovalResponseInShell
methods.seed: Same isolated-store hook with its own fresh id, migrated by a cold relaunch, plus the imported photo fixtures (S3_2WideInput.png, S3_2CloseInput.png). The test creates North Campus / Monument Sign, saves one No visible issue check, then records one approval response as Pat Rivera, Site supervisor. The dark-axxxl states relaunch the same store.

methods.name: test3SettingsAppLockAndCover
methods.seed: Same isolated-store hook with its own fresh id, migrated by a cold relaunch, plus the DEBUG-only --v23-ui-test-local-auth-success Local Authentication stub (honoured only with an accepted isolated store; reports available, every valid attempt succeeds). App Lock must start off and is turned off again at the end; a teardown relaunch turns it off after a failure. The real biometric prompt is not exercised on the Simulator.

states.title: S10 store awaiting restart
states.expectedBehavior: An existing S10 store stops at migration validation on first launch. No shell, welcome or maintenance action is offered; only Retry checks.
reviewChecks: Title reads exactly "Restart to finish updating local data".
Body says local data has been preserved and asks to close and reopen AssetRounds.
Only one action, Retry checks, is shown; no tab bar and no Restore or Erase actions.
S10 background, card and heading colors; text is not clipped.

states.title: Today after migration
states.expectedBehavior: The cold relaunch opens the four-tab shell on Today with the Phase 1 empty state and no planning entry.
reviewChecks: Tab bar shows Today, Work, Assets, Reports in that order, in S10 styling, with Today selected.
Empty state reads exactly "Nothing planned" and "Signs you inspect appear in Assets and Reports."
No Plan button and no My Day list.
Navigation title is Today and the Settings gear is at the top right.

states.title: Work with no completed work
states.expectedBehavior: Work shows only the Completed work section with its empty message and Refresh work; the gated current-work list is absent.
reviewChecks: Completed work section header is shown.
Message reads exactly "Completed reports will appear here."
No "No current work" message, Round rows or saved-draft rows.
Refresh work button uses the S10 secondary style; Work tab is selected.

states.title: Assets welcome
states.expectedBehavior: The accepted S10 welcome lives in the Assets tab of the migrated, empty store.
reviewChecks: Title reads exactly "Turn tonight's sign check into a clear report."
Brand symbol, Add first sign (primary) and View sample are shown.
Colors and typography match the accepted S10 welcome.
Assets tab is selected; no fifth tab and no Signs tab.
If a navigation title is visible, note whether it still reads the incumbent "Signs" under the Assets tab.

states.title: Reports with no reports
states.expectedBehavior: Reports shows the filter card and the empty placeholder.
reviewChecks: Filter reports card shows All sites and All signs.
Empty state reads exactly "Saved reports will appear here."
No report rows; Reports tab is selected.
Settings gear is at the top right.

states.title: Today, dark, AX XXXL
states.expectedBehavior: After a relaunch in Dark mode at Accessibility XXXL, Today keeps the same Phase 1 empty state.
reviewChecks: Dark S10 palette with readable contrast.
"Nothing planned" and its message wrap without truncation or clipping.
Tab bar is usable at the largest size and still has exactly four tabs.
No Plan button.

states.title: Assets welcome, dark, AX XXXL
states.expectedBehavior: The welcome remains readable in Dark mode at Accessibility XXXL; its actions may continue below the fold.
reviewChecks: Brand symbol and title wrap fully without clipping or overlap.
Dark S10 colors match the accepted dark welcome.
Assets tab is selected in a usable tab bar.
Add first sign exists (asserted by test, not visible)

states.title: Check receipt
states.expectedBehavior: Saving a No visible issue check from the Assets tab shows the S10 value receipt once the PDF is ready.
reviewChecks: Reads exactly "Report saved on this device."
View report is enabled and Share PDF is shown.
Done is shown.
S10 receipt styling; no V23 banner or extra action.

states.title: Sign detail after the report
states.expectedBehavior: Done returns to the Monument Sign detail in the Assets tab, now with report history.
reviewChecks: Identity card shows Monument Sign at North Campus.
Assets tab is selected in the four-tab bar.
S10 sign-detail layout is unchanged.
Report history and Start Check exist (asserted by test, not visible)

states.title: Report detail
states.expectedBehavior: Reports lists the one saved visit, and View report opens its report card and PDF preview.
reviewChecks: Report card shows Report ready and the report title.
The top of the PDF preview is visible below the card and is not blank.
Share PDF, Save to Files and Close are pinned at the bottom of the screen.
Reports tab stays selected.

states.title: Completed work list
states.expectedBehavior: Work lists the saved report as one completed-work row with no responses yet.
reviewChecks: One row: Monument Sign, North Campus, the check stage and No visible issue outcome.
Row shows a date and time and a Version label.
Row reads "No responses recorded".
No current-work, Round or saved-draft rows.

states.title: Completed work detail
states.expectedBehavior: The row opens the read-only completed-work detail; the capture is scrolled so More is on screen.
reviewChecks: Navigation title is Completed work.
Facts show Site, Stage, Outcome, Completed, Version and Responses (No responses recorded).
More is shown and no ineligibility reason is shown.
Nothing on the screen is editable.

states.title: Record approval response editor
states.expectedBehavior: More, then Record approval response, opens the response editor bound to this version, at its top.
reviewChecks: Heading reads exactly "Record approval response"; navigation title is Record response.
Intro says the response is a local assertion and does not change the work record.
Completed work card repeats the subject and says Response type Approval response.
Typed name and Claimed role are empty (asserted by test, not visible)

states.title: Response editor fields
states.expectedBehavior: The same editor scrolled to its response fields before anything is typed.
reviewChecks: Your response card shows empty Typed name and Claimed role fields with their prompts.
Claimed relationship reads Not specified.
Field labels and outlines are visible and not clipped.
The drawn mark is optional and not required (asserted by test, not visible)

states.title: Focused response history
states.expectedBehavior: Recording the response switches to Reports and opens the focused, read-only response history.
reviewChecks: Reports tab is selected and the navigation title is Responses.
Current version lists one response: Pat Rivera, Site supervisor.
No Record or edit action on this screen.
"Not verified by AssetRounds" is shown (asserted by test, not visible)

states.title: Response history restored, dark, AX XXXL

reviewChecks: Typed name Pat Rivera is shown in the restored history.
Labels and values wrap without truncation or clipping.
